hypothesis: Rule 110 evolved from a single black cell becomes exactly time-periodic (in the fixed frame in which the right edge of the pattern stays at x = 0) with minimal period 240 steps, and the periodic regime begins about 2780 steps after the start.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered: the smallest P in 1..2000 for which a(t+P, x) = a(t, x) for every cell x in the light cone [-t, 0] and every t from some onset t0 to the end of the run equals 240, and that onset t0 (the smallest t from which the relation holds for all later t up to T - P) lies in [2500, 3060], i.e. within 10% of 2780.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: no P <= 2000 makes the pattern periodic on the light cone for the last 2000 steps of an 8000-step run and 240 is not a period even on the fixed right-edge windows [-500, 0], [-1000, 0] and [-2000, 0]; or the minimal period is not a divisor of 240; or 240 is a period but the onset lies outside [2000, 3500]. Intermediate outcomes (minimal period a proper divisor of 240; periodicity holds only on a restricted window; onset in [2000, 2500) or (3060, 3500]) are pre-registered as 'mixed'.
interpretation: Rule 110 is the Wolfram rule number 110 (rule bit k = new colour for neighbourhood 4*left + 2*centre + right). From a single black cell at x = 0 the pattern occupies only x in [-t, 0] at step t (cells right of the origin stay white), so the natural fixed frame is the one in which the right edge is at rest; Wolfram's figures on pp. 32-39 are drawn in that frame. 'Behavior that repeats every 240 steps' is read as exact time-periodicity of the whole pattern inside the light cone of time t (the cells to the left of -t at time t+P are newly created stripes and are not compared). 'The outcome is finally clear after about 2780 steps' is read as the onset of this exact periodicity, with a 10% tolerance because the text says 'about'. 'One structure survives' is not quantified separately; it is covered by the periodicity of the whole interior.

datasets.name: Elementary cellular automaton rule 110 from a single black cell, 8000 steps (generated by analysis.py)
datasets.program_family: elementary cellular automaton, Wolfram rule number 110; initial condition: single black cell at x = 0 on a line of cells x = -8010..10, white boundaries never reached; steps t = 0..7999; the full space-time array a(t, x) is kept in memory
datasets.role: the evolution whose transient length and period are measured
